rangeMedian: Minimum, maximum and median across three attempts; two decimals.
Medians of p95 values are descriptive, not pooled percentiles.
delta: Absolute median difference, reference percent and range relation.
Unrounded values determine deltas; zero reference gives null percent.
Near-zero references produce large percentages; inspect absolute ranges.
Observed deltas do not establish causal effects.

sourceQualification: Every authoritative measurement uses its clean detached source SHA.
Later test/docs-only descendants are not relabeled as measured heads.
Earlier histories retain their original source and environment records.

reproduction.extended: Add --route-profile exterior, garage or street; one profile per call.
reproduction.driver: Use the recorded driver SHA and its locked dependencies.
reproduction.attempts: Three controlled suites and three fresh-context routes per profile.
reproduction.server: Vite restarts before each route; no smoke override.

environment.scope: Reported configuration matches across phases; physical host is unknown.
environment.server: Vite development; dev/dev labels are not source identities.
environment.renderer: Software WebGL; dangerous-software policy, safe 12 fps cap.
cacheAndNetwork: Fresh contexts/Vite processes; shared OS and dependency caches.
No configured throttling; external network and host load are unmeasured.
concurrentWork: No competing local browser, test, build, compression or upload work.
Light file inspection, report preparation and GitHub checks continued.

qualification: Common before/after comparisons all completed in the original phase.
Final garage/street extensions followed fixture validation and recovery.
Each profile preserves exact timestamps; phases are not pooled.

reason: Hosted artifact materialization overlapped the original extension.
Potential I/O contention cannot be excluded; raw data is retained.
Paused during hosted fixture diagnosis; partial data is retained.
Three suites and two routes completed; route three could not launch.
The same official browser build was reinstalled in the workspace.
A new complete three-attempt extension was captured afterward.

limitations: Hardware timing is unavailable; all hardware-only cases were skipped.
Dispatch latency is not input-to-paint latency.
Rolling diagnostics retain at most 180 intervals and omit gaps >=1000 ms.
Five-second dwell does not prove a checkpoint-isolated rolling window.
External RAF/long-task probes include startup, capture and helper work.
Software-warning UI remains visible; zero dialogs does not mean no overlay.
Historical extension routes differ; common deltas use the matched driver.
Garage/street v3 add door re-approaches while retaining checkpoints.
Route residency differs from the 125-geometry launch ceiling.
Resource counts are not GPU bytes or proof of complete reclamation.
Hardware p95, real-phone performance and owner acceptance stay separate.
